descriptorExport.metric: aiUsageMetric: DxMetric (descriptor aiUsageDescriptor, id dx.metrics.ai-usage, kind metric, readiness ready)
descriptorExport.pure: ledger.ts: accountAiUsage(events) -> AiUsageAccount, accountAiUsageByBranch(events) -> Map<branch, AiUsageAccount> (UNASSIGNED_BRANCH='(no branch)'); normalize.ts: normalizeAiUsage, matchKeysOf, sourceKindFrom

sourceProbe: Consumes ai.usage and ai.turn(with payload.measurements) envelopes as emitted by the in-tree collectors: cursor-local-db (payload.measurements, usd-cents metered), cursor-hooks (rawUsage + semanticsVerified), cursor-usage-export (charge/costLedger/costUsd/tokens, aggregate), cursor-transcripts, claude-jsonl, codex-session, entire, opencode, provider-usage (scope provider-bucket). Real producer output of parseClaudeJsonl on the b11 fixture is accounted with zero uncovered events.

checks.note: 0 diagnostics in B30 files; non-zero exit comes from other owners' files at time of run

accounting.precedence: AI_SOURCE_PRECEDENCE applied per (ledger, category, currency) slot inside a collapsed group
accounting.aggregate: usage-csv rows without request key and provider-bucket rows are alternative ledgers, never summed with detail
accounting.unkeyed: detail rows without keys are counted only when no other source reports the same slot; otherwise unresolved + unassigned
accounting.hooks: stop-hook rawUsage with semanticsVerified!=true is uncovered; normalizedCategories summed only when verified

gaps: Cursor stop-hook usage stays uncovered until a probe sets semanticsVerified (B-hooks owner).
Cumulative usage windows are not differenced.
Aggregate ledgers (usage CSV, provider buckets) have no branch allocation; time-window correlation not implemented here.
Agent/tool-call counts are not part of this metric (payload.toolCalls not summed) to avoid double counting with hook/tool events.
Registration in the metric registry / dx barrel is owned by A02/A07; not done here.
Not yet exercised against a live Cursor store snapshot (no live store present at delivery time).
